plugins.name: splitting-plans
plugins.description: Split large monolithic implementation plans into isolated, dependency-aware sub-plans for parallel subagents

plugins.name: check-diff-coverage
plugins.description: Measure uncovered diff vs main and drive a remediation loop. Supports .NET and Go.

plugins.name: refactor-for-testability
plugins.description: Refactor untestable code into a shape that can be tested before changing behaviour.

plugins.name: research-to-blog
plugins.description: Turn a session insight or a bare topic into a bilingual EN+VI research note and published GitHub Pages blog posts (agent; auto-detects format-and-publish vs self-run deep research).

plugins.name: workflow-journal
plugins.description: Export Claude Code Workflow runs to readable Markdown (every agent's full prompt + result + cost) and auto-capture each run via a Stop hook.

plugins.name: tribe
plugins.description: Five agents under a strict chain of command (Owner ⇄ Shaman ⇄ Warchief ⇄ Hunter, plus two review specialists): the Shaman is the owner's delegate for What & Why and runs the campaign; the Warchief turns one idea card at a time into a merged, evidenced PR via TDD Hunters; the Hunter implements one task under strict TDD; the Tracker reviews every diff against the repo's written rules; the Skinner adversarially audits claimed-done work against its requirement contract by running the proof and rules PASS/FAIL. Questions flow up as statuses, decisions flow down as cards and briefs.

plugins.name: simple-image-video
plugins.description: Animate one still image into a long, seamlessly-looping video with music (e.g. game key-art → 1-hour ambient YouTube loop) via sine-driven Remotion effects: halos, auras, particles, breathing.

plugins.name: verify-shipped
plugins.description: Mechanically verify the tribe's Definition of Done: PR merged, master in sync with origin, worktree removed.

plugins.name: explaining
plugins.description: Two eval-proven rules (term discipline + grounding) that make explanatory prose readable without the writer's context; rule candidates that lost or regressed in the isolated A/B eval are excluded.
